children: Pinterest reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.17 billion, up 11.9% year over year, while net income fell to $21.52 million from $92.11 million and diluted EPS declined to $0.04 from $0.13. Monthly active users increased 10% to 661 million.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share”.
Revenue growth reflected higher advertising volumes and user growth. Ads served increased 17%, while ad prices declined 4%.
Global monthly active users rose 10% to 661 million, supported by investments in relevance and personalization.
U.S. and Canada revenue grew 14%, while Europe revenue was flat. Global average revenue per user increased 1%; U.S. and Canada ARPU rose 10%, Europe declined 7%, and Rest of World increased 9%.
Pinterest completed its restructuring plan in the third quarter, including workforce and office reductions, to refocus resources on AI and sales transformation.
